"""Acceptance check for WashoutPeriodCueExtractor (PR #223).

Verifies the offline cue extractor correctly detects washout/run-in/wash-in
period cues from paper data using deterministic patterns, without network I/O.
"""

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "src")

from retrieval.washout_period_cues import WashoutPeriodCueExtractor, WashoutPeriodCue


def test_import_and_class_exists():
    """Verify the module and class are importable."""
    assert WashoutPeriodCueExtractor is not None
    assert hasattr(WashoutPeriodCueExtractor, "extract")


def test_empty_input_returns_empty_tuple():
    """Empty input should return empty tuple."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    result = extractor.extract([])
    assert result == ()


def test_washout_period_detection():
    """Verify washout period cues are detected."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "p1", "abstract": "After a washout period of 14 days."},
        {"paper_id": "p2", "abstract": "The washout of participants occurred."},
        {"paper_id": "p3", "abstract": "Following a washout phase."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    
    assert len(result) == 3
    
    # First paper: "After a washout period" should match
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "washout_period" in result[0].cues
    assert result[0].paper_id == "p1"
    
    # Second paper: "washout of" should match
    assert result[1].flagged is True
    assert "washout_period" in result[1].cues
    assert result[1].paper_id == "p2"
    
    # Third paper: no washout pattern, should not be flagged
    assert result[2].flagged is False


def test_run_in_period_detection():
    """Verify run-in period cues are detected."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "p1", "abstract": "A placebo run-in period was used."},
        {"paper_id": "p2", "abstract": "During the run-in phase, patients were monitored."},
        {"paper_id": "p3", "abstract": "The study included a 2-week washout."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    
    assert len(result) == 3
    
    # First paper: "placebo run-in" should match
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "run_in_period" in result[0].cues
    assert result[0].paper_id == "p1"
    
    # Second paper: "run-in phase" should match
    assert result[1].flagged is True
    assert "run_in_period" in result[1].cues
    assert result[1].paper_id == "p2"
    
    # Third paper: only washout, not run-in
    assert result[2].flagged is True
    assert "washout_period" in result[2].cues
    assert "run_in_period" not in result[2].cues


def test_wash_in_period_detection():
    """Verify wash-in period cues are detected."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "p1", "abstract": "A wash-in period of 7 days was applied."},
        {"paper_id": "p2", "abstract": "The washin phase lasted 3 weeks."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    
    assert len(result) == 2
    
    # First paper: "wash-in period" should match
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "wash_in_period" in result[0].cues
    assert result[0].paper_id == "p1"
    
    # Second paper: "washin phase" should match
    assert result[1].flagged is True
    assert "wash_in_period" in result[1].cues
    assert result[1].paper_id == "p2"


def test_paper_id_resolution():
    """Verify paper ID resolution from various fields."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    
    # Test with 'id' field
    papers = [{"id": "doi-123", "abstract": "After a washout period."}]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert result[0].paper_id == "doi-123"
    
    # Test with 'doi' field
    papers = [{"doi": "10.1234/test", "abstract": "After a washout period."}]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert result[0].paper_id == "10.1234/test"
    
    # Test with 'document_id' field
    papers = [{"document_id": "doc-456", "abstract": "After a washout period."}]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert result[0].paper_id == "doc-456"
    
    # Test fallback to index-based ID
    papers = [{"abstract": "After a washout period."}]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert result[0].paper_id == "paper-0"


def test_no_false_positives():
    """Verify no false positives for non-matching text."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "p1", "abstract": "The study examined treatment effects."},
        {"paper_id": "p2", "title": "A randomized controlled trial"},
        {"paper_id": "p3", "methods": "We analyzed the data using regression."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    
    for cue in result:
        assert cue.flagged is False, f"Unexpected flag for paper {cue.paper_id}"


def test_matched_text_is_stored():
    """Verify matched text is captured correctly."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    papers = [{"paper_id": "p1", "abstract": "After a washout period of 14 days."}]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    
    assert len(result[0].matched) == 1
    assert "washout period" in result[0].matched[0]


def test_multiple_cues_in_one_paper():
    """Verify multiple cue types can be detected in one paper."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "paper_id": "p1",
            "abstract": "After a washout period, patients entered a run-in phase.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "washout_period" in result[0].cues
    assert "run_in_period" in result[0].cues
    assert len(result[0].matched) == 2


def test_case_insensitivity():
    """Verify pattern matching is case-insensitive."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "p1", "abstract": "AFTER A WASHOUT PERIOD."},
        {"paper_id": "p2", "abstract": "After a Run-In period."},
        {"paper_id": "p3", "abstract": "The Washin phase was used."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    
    assert all(cue.flagged for cue in result), "All papers should be flagged"


def test_text_fields_collected():
    """Verify text is collected from multiple fields."""
    extractor = WashoutPeriodCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "paper_id": "p1",
            "title": "Study Title",
            "abstract": "Abstract text.",
            "summary": "Summary with washout period mention.",
            "methods": "Methods text.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    
    assert result[0].flagged is True, "Should detect washout in summary"


def test_washout_period_cue_dataclass():
    """Verify WashoutPeriodCue dataclass structure."""
    cue = WashoutPeriodCue(
        paper_id="test",
        cue_kind="washout_period",
        cues=("washout_period",),
        matched=("washout period",),
        flagged=True,
    )
    
    assert cue.paper_id == "test"
    assert cue.cue_kind == "washout_period"
    assert cue.cues == ("washout_period",)
    assert cue.matched == ("washout period",)
    assert cue.flagged is True
    
    # Verify it's frozen (immutable)
    try:
        cue.paper_id = "modified"
        assert False, "Should not be able to modify frozen dataclass"
    except Exception:
        pass  # Expected


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pytest
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
